## Simulering av sjakkspillere

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

pop <- rnorm(100000, 100, 15)

sjakk <- rnorm(100000, 115, 15)

results <- data.frame(pval10 = rep(NA, 1000), 
                      pval20 = rep(NA, 1000), 
                      pval40 = rep(NA, 1000), 
                      pval80 = rep(NA, 1000))
for(i in 1:1000) {
  
  # Utvalgsstørrelser 10, 50, 100, 200
  n <- c(10, 20, 40, 80)

  pop10 <- sample(pop, n[1])
  sjakk10 <- sample(sjakk, n[1])
  
  pop50 <- sample(pop, n[2])
  sjakk50 <- sample(sjakk, n[2])
  
  pop100 <- sample(pop, n[3])
  sjakk100 <- sample(sjakk, n[3])
  
  pop200 <- sample(pop, n[4])
  sjakk200 <- sample(sjakk, n[4])
  
  
  ttestresult10 <- t.test(pop10, sjakk10)
  ttestresult50 <- t.test(pop50, sjakk50)
  ttestresult100 <- t.test(pop100, sjakk100)
  ttestresult200 <- t.test(pop200, sjakk200)
  
  results[i,1] <- ttestresult10$p.value
  results[i,2] <- ttestresult50$p.value
  results[i,3] <- ttestresult100$p.value
  results[i,4] <- ttestresult200$p.value
  
}

results |> 
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  mutate( sample_size = as.numeric(
    gsub("pval", "", name)),
    sig = if_else(value < 0.05, 1, 0)) |> 
  summarise(.by = sample_size, 
            frac_sig = sum(sig)/n()) |> 
  print()
  
  
 




```

## Simulering av p-verdier

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

results <- data.frame(pval = rep(NA, 10000))
for(i in 1:10000) {
  
  A <- rnorm(20, 0.5, 0.15)
  B <- rnorm(20, 0.55, 0.15)
  
  test <- t.test(A, B, paired = FALSE)
  
  results[i, 1] <- test$p.value
  
  
}


results |> 
  ggplot(aes(pval)) +  geom_histogram(boundary = 0) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05)





```
